_meta.uncertainty_note: All intervals are REPLICATION uncertainty under common random numbers: bootstrap over seeds at one fixed parameter vector. They do not quantify parameter or structural uncertainty. See E1 for the sigma-gamma sweep, which is where structural uncertainty is measured.
